key.name: enabled
key.summary: Tile windows
key.description: Lay each workspace out as a strip of windows side by side. Off gives GNOME's own floating windows back.

key.name: window-gap
key.summary: The space between two windows, in pixels

key.name: horizontal-margin
key.summary: The space a window keeps from the left and right of the screen when it is scrolled to

key.name: vertical-margin
key.summary: The space between the top bar and the windows

key.name: vertical-margin-bottom
key.summary: The space between the windows and the bottom of the screen

key.name: selection-border-size
key.summary: How far the frame around the focused window stands out, at most; 0 draws none
key.description: The frame never stands out further than the gap between windows or the space below the top bar.

key.name: selection-border-radius-top
key.summary: The roundness of the focus frame's upper corners

key.name: selection-border-radius-bottom
key.summary: The roundness of the focus frame's lower corners

key.name: cycle-width-steps
key.summary: The widths the width key steps through
key.description: Each up to 1 is a share of the screen's width less its margins and one gap, so that two windows of shares adding up to 1 fit side by side; above 1 it is a width in pixels.

key.name: cycle-height-steps
key.summary: The heights the height key steps through, for a window that shares its column

key.name: maximize-width-percent
key.summary: How much of the screen's width less its margins "fill the width" gives a window

key.name: maximize-within-tiling
key.summary: Maximizing a tiled window fills the width instead
key.description: Off, a tiled window maximizes as GNOME has it and covers the screen until it is restored.

key.name: default-focus-mode
key.summary: How a workspace scrolls to the focused window to begin with
key.description: 0 just into view, 1 to the centre, 2 to the nearest edge. Changing it puts every workspace back to it.

key.name: open-window-position
key.summary: Where new windows open
key.description: 0 to the right of the focused window, 1 to its left, 2 at the start of the strip, 3 at its end, 4 below it, 5 above it.

key.name: open-window-position-option-right
key.summary: The key for where new windows open offers "to the right"

key.name: open-window-position-option-left
key.summary: The key for where new windows open offers "to the left"

key.name: open-window-position-option-start
key.summary: The key for where new windows open offers "at the start"

key.name: open-window-position-option-end
key.summary: The key for where new windows open offers "at the end"

key.name: open-window-position-option-down
key.summary: The key for where new windows open offers "below"

key.name: open-window-position-option-up
key.summary: The key for where new windows open offers "above"

key.name: animation-time
key.summary: Seconds a window takes to glide to its place, before GNOME's own animation speed

key.name: drift-speed
key.summary: Pixels a millisecond the strip slides while a slide key is held

key.name: drag-drift-speed
key.summary: Pixels a millisecond the strip slides while a window is dragged against a side of the screen

key.name: minimap-scale
key.summary: The size of the map of the strip shown while moving around; 0 shows none

key.name: minimap-shade-opacity
key.summary: How dark the windows not chosen get while the map is shown; 0 leaves them as they are

key.name: edge-preview-enable
key.summary: Pushing the pointer against a side of the screen shows the window beyond it

key.name: edge-preview-scale
key.summary: The size of the window shown at a side of the screen

key.name: edge-preview-click-enable
key.summary: A click at a side of the screen goes to the window beyond it

key.name: edge-preview-timeout-enable
key.summary: Keeping the pointer at a side of the screen goes to the window beyond it

key.name: edge-preview-timeout
key.summary: Milliseconds the pointer stays at a side of the screen before it goes to the window beyond it

key.name: edge-preview-timeout-continual
key.summary: Keeping the pointer there goes on to the next window, and the next

key.name: gesture-enabled
key.summary: Touchpad swipes move the strip and open the workspaces

key.name: gesture-horizontal-fingers
key.summary: The fingers a sideways swipe that slides the strip takes; 0 for none

key.name: gesture-workspace-fingers
key.summary: The fingers a downward swipe that opens the recent workspaces takes; 0 for none

key.name: swipe-sensitivity
key.summary: How far the strip and the workspaces move for each pixel the fingers do

key.name: swipe-friction
key.summary: How soon the strip and the workspaces stop after the fingers let go; more stops sooner

key.name: show-focus-mode-icon
key.summary: The top bar shows how the workspace scrolls to a window

key.name: show-open-position-icon
key.summary: The top bar shows where new windows open

key.name: default-show-top-bar
key.summary: The top bar is shown on every workspace unless it is hidden there
key.description: Off, it is hidden on every workspace unless it is shown there.

key.name: topbar-mouse-scroll-enable
key.summary: The mouse wheel over the top bar moves to the window on the left or right
key.description: The workspaces in the top bar use the wheel to change workspace, which this takes from them.

key.name: window-switcher-preview-scale
key.summary: The size of the windows in the window switcher (Alt+Tab), a share of the screen's height

key.name: show-workspace-indicator
key.summary: The top bar shows the name of the workspace, and each other screen the name of its own
key.description: A click opens the overview, the right button a menu to rename it, and the wheel goes to the workspace before or after it. The workspaces in the top bar stay as they are.

key.name: show-window-position-bar
key.summary: A line under the top bar shows where the focused window is in the strip
key.description: Each other screen has one at its top for its own workspace.

key.name: only-scratch-in-overview
key.summary: The overview shows only the floating windows

key.name: disable-scratch-in-overview
key.summary: The overview leaves the floating windows out

key.name: overview-ensure-viewport-animation
key.summary: How the strip comes to the focused window when the overview closes: 0 at once, 1 gliding, 2 fading in

key.name: workspace-names
key.summary: Each workspace's name, by its number from the first; empty for "Workspace N"
key.description: Shown by the workspace name in the top bar and on the workspace cards. GNOME's own workspace names are left as they are.

key.name: workspace-directories
key.summary: Each workspace's folder, by its number from the first; empty for none
key.description: Apps started while the workspace is shown start in its folder. A path, ~ for the home folder.

key.name: workspace-colors
key.summary: Each workspace's colour, by its number from the first; empty for the theme's
key.description: As #rrggbb. It frames the workspace's card while you go through the workspaces, and fills what its own picture leaves.

key.name: workspace-backgrounds
key.summary: Each workspace's own picture, by its number from the first; empty for the default
key.description: A file's path or address. A workspace without one shows default-background, or else GNOME's own wallpaper (unless use-default-background is off).

key.name: default-background
key.summary: The picture of every workspace without one of its own; empty for GNOME's own wallpaper

key.name: use-default-background
key.summary: A workspace without a picture of its own shows GNOME's wallpaper
key.description: Off, it shows its colour alone.

key.name: winprops
key.summary: Window rules
key.description: Each a JSON object: "wm_class" and/or "title" (a string, "/a pattern/flags", or "*" for every window nothing else matches), and what to do: "scratch_layer" (float it), "preferredWidth" ("50%" or "800px"), "spaceIndex" (the workspace to open on, from 0), "focus" (go to it when it opens there), "oneshot" (forget the rule once it is used).
